story.title: Background
paragraphs: M.Sc. in Robotics with experience in machine learning, systems development, and full-stack development. Hands-on experience with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core Web API, PostgreSQL, React, and TypeScript, as well as building REST-based applications with authentication and role-based access control. Also experienced in deploying applications to Microsoft Azure and Firebase.

items.description: Currently studying the development of web applications and cloud services.
Participated in employment preparation activities and studied Swedish and English to strengthen my communication skills and prepare for professional life in Sweden.

Studied robotics, embedded systems, artificial intelligence, and electronics. For my master's thesis, I developed a radar-based hand gesture recognition system using Python, TensorFlow, and convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The system achieved 95% classification accuracy with a prediction time of approximately 25 ms.
items.thesis: Implementation of Machine Learning Algorithm for Radar-Based Hand Gesture Recognition
